name: Asset Alchemist
title: Video Vault Ultra Import — Large Local Files & Wider Format Support
subtitle: Video Vault Ultra Import — Large Local Files & Wider Format Support
features: Removed the previous 450 MB iPhone/iPad and 750 MB PC single-video limits, replacing them with generous 8 GB mobile and 16 GB desktop safety guardrails while respecting actual browser storage quotas and free device capacity

Introduced chunked large-file saves in the browser’s private origin filesystem (OPFS) where writable; older or unsupported browsers use smaller 16 MB IndexedDB chunks instead of one enormous Blob transaction

Preserved the exact existing Video Vault database and all previously saved videos, thumbnails, watch history, favorites and collections; the additive database upgrade creates a new chunk store without deleting original files

Expanded the import picker and filename/MIME validation to accept MP4, MOV, M4V, WebM, OGV, MKV, AVI, WMV, FLV, MPEG, TS/MTS/M2TS, 3GP, HEVC and additional supported video MIME types, keeping unsupported codecs exportable rather than pretending they play
Added import progress with bytes and percentage, cancellation that discards partial imports on supported paths, clearer failure reasons for quota/unsupported files and browser storage guidance

Added Play from Files — no copy: play a user-selected large video directly from its iPhone/PC file picker without copying its data into browser-managed storage; Save this preview optionally persists it when quotas permit
Added safer streamed-file integrity checks and native video playback with existing full-screen, picture-in-picture, snapshots and existing resume/bookmark controls where applicable

Preserved Web Cinema Embed First, Sonic Theater saved music and Play on Start, Mobile Power Guard, ORBIT PC/iPhone layout, all other studios, media exports, previous rollback packages and direct Discord release automation
